title: Elements as Checkboxes – Functions (assessment)
summary:
In this example, JSXGraph function graphs can be used as "checkboxes". By adding to a function graph's attributes, this element becomes clickable.
The input parameter defines whether the function graphs behave as a checkbox or a radio button .

When such an function graph is clicked, the are stored in the result array.
